annotations.title: Transcribe a podcast or media link

description: Transcribe a public podcast or media link with speech-to-text (and built-in captions on TikTok when available). Use it for Apple Podcasts, Spotify, TikTok, Instagram Reel/Post, RSS feed links, and direct audio/video URLs (ending in .mp3, .m4a, .wav, .mp4, .webm and similar); YouTube links use transcriptlab_get_transcript. Spends credits per audio minute (or 1 credit for TikTok built-in captions). Returns a media_id: poll transcriptlab_get_speech_transcript with it, waiting a few seconds between tries and stopping after about ten.

chunks.description: Split transcript into o200k_base token chunks (true for defaults, or { max_tokens, overlap_tokens }).

diarize.description: Label speakers; defaults to false. Implies tier=premium.

engine.description: Extraction mode; defaults to auto (TikTok built-in captions when available, else speech-to-text). captions never starts speech-to-text and fails when the link has no built-in captions; stt always transcribes the audio.

lang.description: Optional ISO 639-1 spoken language hint (e.g. "ar", "en", "es"); omit or "auto" to auto-detect.

markdown.description: Include timestamped Markdown rendering on cached/completed JSON responses.

tier.description: Speech model tier; defaults to auto (normal when available).

url.description: Public https URL of a podcast episode/show, RSS feed, TikTok video, Instagram Reel/Post, or audio/video file.

name: transcriptlab_transcribe_media_url
title: Transcribe a podcast or media link
